items.description: Your grocery list as mashup. Use a barcode scanner and this service to keep track of your running grocery list. Uses data from the UPC Database web service.

This unique road trip planner locates hundreds of points of interest along the trail pioneered by the Lewis and Clark Expedition. Find historic sites, national parks, state parks, campgrounds and much more. Great way to plan a family vacation!
Soccer Shots is a intro-to-soccer provider across the globe. Its messaging system uses the AT&T in-app messaging API.
Signin.in is a travel booking company that offers different types of booking services such as air ticket, bus tickets, train tickets, car rentals, holiday packages, and more.
mygoogleplus.com uses Google+ API to transform user profile into a Facebook style timeline.
